caption: A hot oven door is opened, and the air above the opening shimmers and wavers.

sa.check: The air above the opening shimmers.
The shimmer is strongest just above the opening.
The opening comes first and the shimmer follows.

pc.expect: The shimmer rises out of the oven's mouth and fades with height; it does not flow down toward the floor.
pc.fail: The shimmer flows down the oven door and pools on the floor; or sinks below the opening; or pours downward out of the oven; or hangs as a fixed band without rising.

pc.expect: The shimmer appears as the door opens and eases as the oven cools, and the wavering keeps moving upward and outward.
pc.fail: The shimmer appears before the door has moved; or runs back into the oven; or thickens steadily after the door has been shut; or the wavering freezes into a fixed pattern.

pc.expect: The shimmer sits above the open mouth and things seen through it waver, while the view away from the mouth stays steady.
pc.fail: The shimmer appears above a closed part of the oven; or the view through the shimmer stays perfectly steady; or the whole room wavers while the shimmer sits over the mouth; or the shimmer appears with the door still shut.

pc.expect: The oven and the things around it stay put; only the air above the mouth moves.
pc.fail: The door swings further open or shuts by itself; or items on the hob jump as the door opens; or the oven shifts; or the racks inside slide out by themselves.

pc.expect: One oven with one door; the contents of the oven are the same as the door opens.
pc.fail: Food in the oven appears or vanishes; or a rack vanishes; or the door passes through the oven's frame; or the oven changes shape.

pc.expect: The oven's front, its controls and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The oven changes colour; or the controls rearrange; or items in the kitchen rearrange.
